prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production 2D GAME VFX animation SPRITE SHEET, actual painted consecutive frames, RGBA transparent background. Create a new effect asset, NOT a card redesign. Match the supplied approved colorful light-fantasy hand-painted card illustrations: bright cartoon, crisp expressive paint strokes, simplified readable forms. No photography, realistic 3D, PBR, heavy metal ornament, CSS-looking blurred circles. No card artwork, no text, no grid lines, no labels, no backdrop, no colored fog rectangles, no checkerboard baked into pixels.
CRITICAL EXACT LAYOUT: square 1536x1536 sheet divided into exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 identical 384x384 cells. Place cell centers at x=192,576,960,1344 and y=192,576,960,1344. Leave at least 32 transparent pixels on every cell edge. Each individual effect stays inside its own cell. Chronological LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM. Every frame is newly painted with evolving texture and deformed energy streams, never copies simply scaled/rotated. Stable registered anchor in the center of each cell. Truly transparent soft antialiased alpha on glow contours; no opaque ground or vignette.
TOP EIGHT CELLS = card activation frames 1-8, played in 240ms. Transparent portrait card-shaped magical BORDER only, approximately width148 height212 centered at192,192 in each cell, without painting a card underneath. f1 faint first luminous stroke on bottom corners; f2 magical streams climb edges; f3 and f4 streams curl along sides to top; f5 bright corners gather inward strands; f6-f7 inward threads converge toward center; f8 central compressed magical glow ready to release. Border and inner filament shapes actually flow each frame.
BOTTOM EIGHT CELLS = release frames 1-8, played in 200ms. Keep center192,192. f1 bright thin border flash and compact glowing kernel at card center; f2-f3 bright burst from card center, sweeping fine filaments detach from border; f4-f5 ribbons curl into a painted round energy kernel with decorative asymmetric streams; f6-f7 border fades and kernel consolidates; f8 small stable magical orb diameter86 with tiny trailing sparks, ready to fly. Largest burst fits diameter270. No movement of anchor across cells. Release originates from the card center. Complete sequential motion, consistent object volume and gradual transitions.
TYPE: ATTACK red-orange and warm GOLD. Hand-painted curling flame-like magic filaments, ember shard sparks, muscular jagged ribbon flow. It is generic arcane attack, not a specific fire skill. Strong punchy converging strokes.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Do not reproduce any card artwork or text.
